Hi Jess 😊
I hope you’re doing well! I’m reaching out about your aircon room in Spring Hill!
I’m French and have been living in Australia for the past 3 years all in Melbourne and I’ve just secured a new job in Brisbane so I’m planning to relocate within the next month I’m actually looking for something around the end of March or beginning of April.
A bit about me I’m tidy respectful easy going and pretty independent I also enjoy a friendly and relaxed home environment
I’m currently in Brisbane for work this week until Tuesday I’ll be working office hours on Monday and Tuesday but I’m free after that I was wondering if you might be available for a quick chat and an inspection during this time
Thanks so much and I look forward to hearing from you ✨
Livia
